name: Nodusfall
summary:
Nodusfall is a cooperative action game developed by miHoYo and published globally by HoYoverse. Set in a dark fantasy world where divine authority has collapsed, players take on the role of Weavers: warriors who band together to confront mythic beasts corrupted by entities known as the Dreadnodi, and to restore order to a fractured continent.

Squads of up to four players face large-scale bosses drawn from a mix of world mythologies. Combat centres on stamina management, tactical coordination and sustained pressure to expose enemy weak points, supported by a thread-based light ability used to close distance, reposition and revive fallen allies. Players choose from characters with distinct roles and weapon styles, and spend resources earned in combat to unlock new weapons and abilities.
